Chol re Chopoltoruun dal on Independence Day
2019-03-20T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/music/news/chol-re-chopoltoruun-dal-independence-day-1717447

The latest installment of the song, Chol re Chopoltoruun Dal by Gems of Nazrul, is set to hit TV screens on March 26. Gems of Nazrul is an initiative to portray National Poet Kazi Nazrul Islam's musical genius in new light and popularise his spirited songs.

A tribute to Bangladesh's Independence Day, this patriotic Nazrul song has been performed by several leading exponents including Sadya Afreen Mallick, Dalia Nausheen, Fatema Tuz Zohra, Iffat Ara Nargis, Yasmin Mushtari, Shelu Borua along with talented singers Tanvir Alam Shawjeeb, Tanzina Karim Sharalipi, Champa Banik, Waqueel Ahad and students of Nazrul Institute and Music College. The 8th production by Gems of Nazrul, is directed and coordinated by Sadya Afreen Mallick, whereas the soundtrack has been arranged by Tanvir Alam Shawjeeb. Barobhoot was the DOP for the video, which is partly sponsored by Mutual Trust Bank and Ispahani Tea Ltd.
